headline: Montage Health announces the arrival of next-generation robotic surgery systems.
summary: Three new robotic surgical systems have arrived to the Community Hospital of the Monterey Peninsula, for what is professed by parent company Montage Health to be the largest robot-assisted surgery program on the Central Coast.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
